summary: Reviewer rejected a claim due to suspicious claimant details.
safeUse: Route similar future claimant pattern to human review.
mustNotDo: use prior rejection as policy evidence
draft denial reason based only on memory

summary: Reviewer requested police report for a third-party claim.
safeUse: For similar third-party claims, check whether police report evidence is present before policy lookup.
mustNotDo: mark the new claim as missing police report without current validation

summary: Workflow escalated because retrieved policy evidence was insufficient for a final decision.
safeUse: When current policy retrieval is insufficient, route to human review instead of drafting a final decision.
mustNotDo: draft approval or denial without current evidence
treat an old evidence gap as current coverage outcome

summary: Agent drafted an approval note only after current policy retrieval had enough evidence.
safeUse: Remind the agent that approval notes require enough current policy evidence and remain drafts.
mustNotDo: use memory as the coverage citation
